standouts.head: Volume leads price higher
standouts.text: On-balance volume is at a 52-week high while price is still under its own: buying is running ahead of price.
standouts.learn: A running total of volume on up days minus down days; when it leads price, price tends to follow.

standouts.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
standouts.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Oct 5) against a lower low in MACD histogram, stochastic and CCI: hidden bullish divergence.
standouts.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

standouts.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
standouts.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
standouts.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Breaking out of an ascending triangle
material.text: Sellers have capped it at the same level twice while each dip stops higher: it has now closed above that ceiling. The break session closed 1.2 ATR past the line on a 1.6-ATR range.
material.learn: A flat ceiling with rising lows: buyers keep paying more.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Sitting on stacked support
material.text: Price sits on the buy zone, where 3 levels (2 kinds) meet.
material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly: wave 4 turning up from its zone
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Mar 23 to Aug 10 (+30%; wave 3 is 1.9 times wave 1). The pullback turned up from the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (−3.8% to −6.3%), on lighter volume, with the 38.2% retracement of the Mar 9–Aug 10 rise in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−9.1%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: A higher high and a higher low
material.text: Its last swing high and swing low each topped the one before.
material.learn: Rising swing highs and lows are the steps of an uptrend.

standouts.head: Momentum holding a bull range
standouts.text: RSI has stayed above 42 on every dip for three months and reached 69: the range momentum holds in an uptrend.

standouts.head: In a 13-week base
standouts.text: It has moved sideways for 13 weeks in a range 16% deep after a +40% advance.

standouts.head: Accumulation
standouts.text: In five weeks it had 4 up days and 0 down days on volume above both the day before and its average.
